name: toothless-hidden-world-webgl
description: Photorealistic, fully rigged web-native 3D model of Toothless (The Hidden World x Live-Action Hybrid) in Three.js WebGL2

scripts.build:vercel: if [ "$VITE_APP_MODE" = "developer" ]; then VITE_APP_MODE=developer npm run build; else tsc --noEmit && VITE_APP_MODE=user vite build --outDir dist && VITE_APP_MODE=developer vite build --outDir dist/dev; fi
scripts.sync:docs: tsc --noEmit && VITE_APP_MODE=user vite build --outDir dist-user && VITE_APP_MODE=developer vite build --outDir dist-dev && rm -rf docs/assets docs/dev && cp -r dist-user/* docs/ && mkdir -p docs/dev && cp -r dist-dev/* docs/dev/ && touch docs/.nojekyll
